description: This file defines the Upload model class within the Opencart system, responsible for managing upload records in the database such as adding new uploads and retrieving them by code.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Model class for handling file uploads in Opencart, including creating new upload entries and retrieving uploads by code.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with a generated token code, and returns this code.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves upload information from the database based on the provided code.
